sources.articleTitle: Kim A-lim retains lead at LPGA Tour Championship, eyes $4 million prize
Kim A-lim falters late, ties for 7th at LPGA season finale

headline: Kim A-Lim Finishes T7 At The LPGA CME Group Tour Championship
seoTitle: Kim A-Lim Ties For 7th At LPGA Tour Championship
metaDescription: South Korean golfer Kim A-Lim concluded her appearance at the season-ending LPGA CME Group Tour Championship with a seventh-place tie in Naples, Florida.
aiSummaryBullets: Kim A-Lim entered the final round of the CME Group Tour Championship as a front-runner for the tournament title.
The golfer carded a 3-under 69 in the third round at Tiburon Golf Club to maintain a lead.
Following a late-round performance decline, Kim finished the LPGA season finale in a tie for seventh place.
aiContextParagraph: The CME Group Tour Championship is the concluding event of the LPGA Tour season, held at the Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida. The tournament features a significant purse, totaling $11 million, with a top prize of $4 million for the winner. Kim A-Lim, a prominent South Korean professional golfer, entered the final stages of the competition as a primary contender after maintaining a lead through the first three rounds. Her performance throughout the tournament included a third-round effort of 3-under 69, characterized by six birdies and three bogeys. Despite her position at the top of the leaderboard heading into the final stages of the event, Kim encountered challenges in the latter part of her play, ultimately resulting in a tie for seventh place in the overall standings of the season finale.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by two independent outlets due to the high-stakes nature of the LPGA season-ending tournament and the golfer's initial lead.
